oorexx_maths v0.12 named pseudo-constant qualification
====================================================

Runtime:
  oorexx-5.3.0-13196.ubuntu1604debug.x86_64(20260925-083247).deb

Focused named-constant regression:
  tests/test_named_constants.rex
  4/4 executed assertions PASS

Pure/core package lane:
  MATHS_TEST_NUMPY=0
  MATHS_TEST_PROOF_PROVIDERS=0
  MATHS_TEST_CRYPTO=0
  ./run_tests.sh
  rc=0

Full accelerated qualification was attempted but the supplied ooRexx .deb does
not contain python_foreign.cls, so the existing NumPy/foreign-provider lane
cannot be rerun in this isolated runtime. The stop occurs at MathNumpyProvider's
existing ::requires 'python_foreign.cls' boundary, not in named-constant code.

Public contract added:
  .Maths~namedConstant('pi', context)

Compatibility:
  .Maths~constant(value, context) is unchanged.
  .Maths~pi(context) remains public and now delegates to the named-constant cache.

Cache key:
  constant name + numeric domain + MathContext working precision

Observed representations:
  decimal(30):
    3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510582097494
  decimal(70):
